response.overview: # Translation  The story follows Hana (Hanna Delisha), a successful career woman living a happy life with her husband, Dr Reza (Fattah Amin), a psychology doctor whom she has known since university. Blessed with a daughter, their life seems perfect until the sudden reappearance of Azmeer (Nazrief Nazri), an old acquaintance who reopens a past chapter that Reza never knew about. The reunion initially causes no problems. In fact, Reza is delighted to reconnect with their old acquaintance. However, behind his appearance, Azmeer actually harbors a grudge against Hana and begins plotting to destroy their marriage. Various manipulations and false accusations are created until Reza himself begins to doubt his wife's faithfulness. Several deliberately planted clues lead Reza to believe that Hana is having an affair. It culminates in an incident involving Hana and Azmeer that makes Reza completely convinced that Hana has betrayed him.
